BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF JANUARY 8, 2019 AND JANUARY 10, 2019
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of January 8, 2019 and January 10, 2019.
A-1 Minutes 1-8-19 CC SA
A-1 Minutes 1-10-19 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF COMPREHENSIVE SCHEDULE OF FEES AND CHARGES ASSESSED BY THE CITY FOR SERVICES AND MUNICIPAL ACTIVITIES PROVIDED TO THE PUBLIC
It is recommended that the City Council direct staff to re-advertise the public hearing on the Comprehensive Schedule of Fees and Charges when the matter is ready to be heard.
B-1 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Update Staff Report
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF COLOR SELECTION FOR CITY STREET NAME SIGNS
It is recommended that the City Council make a selection of the preferred sign color.
C-1 Street Name Signs Color Selection Staff Report
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1463
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 19-5463 approving Warrant Register No. 1463.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1463
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF APPOINTMENT OF CITY MANAGER TO THE CIVIC-RECREATIONAL-INDUSTRIAL AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council appoint City Manager Bob Lindsey to the Civic-Recreational-Industrial Authority Board.
D-2 CRIA Appointment Staff Report
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER FOR THE USE OF THE CITY’S GYMNASIUM AT THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER BY THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT INDUSTRY STATION YOUTH ACTIVITIES LEAGUE (YAL) KEMPO PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5464 approving a request for a fee waiver for the Industry Sheriff’s Station Youth Activities League to hold classes for the YAL Kempo program at the City’s gymnasium at the La Puente Community Center in the amount of $2,970.
D-3 YAL Kempo Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-3 YAL Kempo Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF A PURCHASE ORDER CONTRACT WITH NATIONAL AUTO FLEET GROUP FOR PURCHASE OF TWO NEW 2019 FORD F-150 XLT TRUCKS BY UTILIZING A COOPERATIVE PURCHASE CONTRACT THROUGH SOURCEWELL (FORMERLY NATIONAL JOINT POWERS ALLIANCE)
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve purchase order contract with National Auto Fleet Group for purchase of two new 2019 Ford F-150 XLT by utilizing a cooperative purchase contract through Sourcewell (formerly National Joint Powers Alliance); and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute, on behalf of the City, all documents necessary to effectuate this action.
D-4 Vehicle Purchase F150 Trucks Staff Report
D-4 Vehicle Purchase F150 Trucks Attachment A Quote
D-5
PRESENTATION OF OCTOBER, NOVEMBER AND DECEMBER 2018 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORTS
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the reports.
D-5 Oct Nov Dec Requisition Summary Report Staff Report
D-5 Oct Nov Dec Requisition Summary Report Attachment A Report
D-6
PRESENTATION OF OCTOBER 2018 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-6 October Investment Report Staff Report
D-6 October Investment Report Attachments A-E
D-7
PRESENTATION OF NOVEMBER 2018 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-7 November Investment Report Staff Report
D-7 November Investment Report Attachments A-E
D-8
PRESENTATION OF DECEMBER 2018 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-8 December Investment Report Staff Report
D-8 December Investment Report Attachments A-E
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
UPDATE AND DISCUSSION ON THE CITY OF LA PUENTE'S NEIGHBORHOOD CANVASS PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the presentation.
E-1 Neighborhood Canvass Program Update Staff Report

Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
